tools.name: search_ai_tools
tools.description: Search the BroFindAI directory of 960+ AI tools by keyword, category, pricing, platform, tags, API availability, or open-source status. Returns matching tools with full structured metadata.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all AI tool categories in the BroFindAI directory with the number of tools in each category.

tools.name: get_tool_details
tools.description: Get full details of a specific AI tool by its slug identifier (e.g. 'chatgpt', 'midjourney'). Returns name, description, URL, category, pricing, votes, and metadata.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List every tag and platform in use across the directory with tool counts, plus how many tools have a known/unknown API and open-source status. Call this to discover valid filter values for search_ai_tools.

tools.name: list_mcp_servers
tools.description: Browse the BroFindAI MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers directory. Filter by category or search by keyword.
